steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each category is placed by its baseline, its approach and its owner.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 2 categories need a baseline or an owner

findings.title: Category target with no baseline
findings.fix: Record last year's spend as the baseline

findings.title: Category with spend and no owner
Strategy note conflicts with a contract
findings.fix: Reconcile the note to the contract

outcome.notChecked: Market forecasts, and strategy beyond the notes given.
